limitations.note: The rewrite stopped the counter from advancing on invalid cycles, but it also removed the registered reset behavior of ready_a and gated valid_b on the sixth accepted bit instead of preserving the original count comparison.

The test required ready_a to be high even during reset and expected valid_b to stay low during stalls before the sixth bit, encoding the rewrite’s timing rather than checking that the original timing was preserved.
